# Constitution Alignment Checklist: Unified Table Processing and Atomic Transaction Optimization

**Purpose**: Review whether spec 039's requirements, plan, and tasks are written so they satisfy the KalamDB constitution. This is a requirements-quality review. It does not check that the implementation follows the constitution.
**Created**: 2026-11-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)
**Constitution**: [`.specify/memory/constitution.md`](../../../.specify/memory/constitution.md) version 1.0.0

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Does the plan include a constitution check that maps every principle, the architecture constraints, and the workflow gates, including User Story 8? [Completeness, Constitution §Workflow, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK002 Are hot-path requirements written so a new SQL rewrite, a second orchestration layer, or framework-specific work in a shared crate needs a measured benefit? [Completeness, Constitution §I, Spec §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK003 Are performance requirements required to record runtime in seconds for every benchmark and perf case, including the OpenRaft before/after workloads? [Completeness, Constitution §I, Spec §SC-009, Spec §SC-017]
- [ ] CHK004 Are crate ownership requirements specified for filesystem work, key-value engine work, and orchestration, including where the Raft log store is allowed to live? [Completeness, Constitution §II, Spec §FR-033, Spec §FR-051]
- [ ] CHK005 Are new or bumped dependencies required to name the smallest feature set, the crate that needs them, and an explicit exception when an existing pin changes? [Completeness, Constitution §III, Plan §Complexity Tracking, Spec §FR-048]
- [ ] CHK006 Does the plan define a focused executable validation for every user story, including Story 8, before implementation of that story? [Completeness, Constitution §IV, Spec §US8 independent test]
- [ ] CHK007 Is each user story required to stay independently testable, so a later story is not the only proof of an earlier one? [Completeness, Constitution §IV, tasks.md phase checkpoints]
- [ ] CHK008 Are architecture-affecting requirements required to update the spec, the plan, the tasks, and the public contract together when the boundary changes? [Completeness, Constitution §Architecture, Spec §FR-037]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK009 Is "lower runtime cost" quantified where the feature allows a regression, including the 5% allowance and the zero-regression catalog gate, so the constitution's preference has a written limit? [Clarity, Constitution §I, Spec §SC-009, Spec §SC-015, Spec §SC-017]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "measured benefit" defined with a metric, a repeat count, and a comparison point before a hot-path exception is allowed? [Clarity, Gap, Constitution §I, Spec §FR-055]
- [ ] CHK011 Is principle V either mapped to a backend requirement that matches its UI wording, or marked not applicable because this feature has no shared UI surface? [Clarity, Constitution §V, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the dev-profile measurement rule written as an explicit exception or as compatible with the constitution's preference for lower runtime cost? [Clarity, Spec Assumptions, Constitution §I, Constitution §Governance]
- [ ] CHK013 Are "narrowest executable check" gates named for Story 8, rather than only a workspace-wide suite? [Clarity, Constitution §Workflow, quickstart.md §6]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK014 Does the constitution check's principle I row account for Story 8's latency bound, or does it only justify the table-processing program? [Consistency, Plan §Constitution Check, Spec §SC-017]
- [ ] CHK015 Does the constitution check's principle IV row include SC-015, SC-016, and SC-017, or does it stop at SC-014? [Consistency, Plan §Constitution Check, Spec §SC-016, Spec §SC-017]
- [ ] CHK016 Does principle II's mapping stay consistent with a Raft log that uses RocksDB outside `kalamdb-store`, and is that placement an explicit exception? [Consistency, Constitution §II, Spec §FR-051, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK017 Do the spec, the plan, and the tasks name one winning document when they disagree, given that the constitution supersedes feature artifacts? [Consistency, Constitution §Governance, Spec §US8, Plan header, tasks.md header]
- [ ] CHK018 Does the complexity-tracking section state every dependency exception the constitution check relies on, including optional Raft crates that are not yet adopted? [Consistency, Constitution §Workflow, Plan §Complexity Tracking, Spec §FR-055]
- [ ] CHK019 Does a latency gate remain forbidden from dropping an authorization or durability requirement? [Consistency, Constitution §I, Spec §FR-039, Spec §FR-051, Spec §SC-015]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK020 Can a reviewer decide the constitution check is current, because it cites the constitution version and was updated when Story 8 was added? [Measurability, Gap, Constitution §Workflow, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK021 Can principle III be decided as pass or as a named exception from the written feature set of the OpenRaft pin, without inferring features from a task? [Measurability, Constitution §III, Spec §FR-048]
- [ ] CHK022 Can principle IV be decided for this feature by stating whether any `link/sdks/**` surface changes, and therefore whether the SDK doc rule applies? [Measurability, Gap, Constitution §IV, Spec §FR-037]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements specified for the case where a constitution principle does not apply, so the check records not-applicable instead of a pass by analogy? [Coverage, Gap, Constitution §V, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements specified for a failed constitution gate, including that implementation does not start past that gate? [Coverage, Constitution §Governance, Constitution §Workflow]
- [ ] CHK025 Are recovery requirements specified when a dependency bump fails its safety gate, so the plan cannot keep a partial exception? [Coverage, Constitution §III, Spec §FR-055]
- [ ] CHK026 Are requirements specified for operator docs that live outside the workspace, including when those updates cannot be validated locally? [Coverage, Gap, Constitution §Architecture, Spec §FR-037]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK027 Are requirements specified when `AGENTS.md` and the constitution give different measurement or dependency guidance, so the constitution wins? [Edge Case, Constitution §Governance, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK028 Are generated outputs identified, with a requirement that this feature does not hand-edit them? [Edge Case, Gap, Constitution §Architecture]
- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements specified for a story whose independent test needs a cluster, so that story still has a falsifiable gate short of the full workspace suite? [Edge Case, Constitution §Workflow, Spec §US8]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK030 Is the constitution version that this plan claims to satisfy identified in the plan? [Dependencies, Gap, Constitution header, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK031 Is reuse of the existing Raft manager and store written as the constitution's reuse rule, with upstream example stores excluded? [Assumption, Constitution §III, Spec §FR-051]
- [ ] CHK032 Does the plan state that a later constitution amendment must be reviewed against this feature's active plan and tasks in the same change? [Dependencies, Constitution §Workflow]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Security access control is reviewed in `security.md`. OpenRaft requirement wording is reviewed in `openraft.md`. This file asks whether those requirements, and the rest of spec 039, are written so they meet the constitution.
- Items are numbered CHK001–CHK032.
